calculation.expression: -(12-session cumulative residual return)/(20-session residual volatility) * clip(40-session mean residual volatility/current 20-session residual volatility, 0.5, 2.0)
calculation.description: For each tradable asset, remove its causal 60-session rolling beta exposure to the equal-weight cross-asset return benchmark, reverse the recent 12-session idiosyncratic move, normalize by causal 20-session residual volatility, and amplify compressed-volatility snapback setups. All inputs are lagged through the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: 10-day IC was -0.006222 over 2023-2025 (97 dates), +0.031065 over 2026-2028 (590), +0.031005 over 2029-2031 (783), and +0.044119 over 2032-2035-08-30 (945). Interpret uncertainty conservatively given the 15-asset cross-section.
